description: Page header: cover image (with drag repositioning), icon (emoji picker), title (contenteditable), and optional description.

parameters.name: OnCommentBadgeClicked
parameters.description: Fired when the comment badge in the header is clicked.

parameters.name: OnPageUpdated
parameters.description: When true, displays a visible page-level restricted access indicator in the header.

parameters.name: OnTitleEnterPressed
parameters.description: Fired when Enter is pressed in the title, signalling to add a new block.

parameters.name: ShowRestrictedIndicator
parameters.description: When true, displays a visible page-level restricted access indicator in the header.

parameters.name: ShowMeta
parameters.description: Opt-in meta row under the title: last-edited time (relative, absolute in the title tooltip), the last editor (TmAvatar + name resolved through the mention provider, raw id fallback) and the unresolved comment count as a link (fires OnCommentBadgeClicked). Defaults to false.

parameters.name: UnresolvedCommentCount
parameters.description: Total unresolved comment count for the page (header badge).
